mechanism.claim: When directional participation across six liquid alt perpetuals rises steadily through a completed eight-hour auction, price discovery is diffusing from a narrow impulse into market-wide repricing. During elevated BTC variation, follow the aggregate alt direction for eight elapsed hours at a fresh upper-tail participation-slope state.
mechanism.side: strict sign of the sum of six completed eight-hour alt log returns
mechanism.why_distinct: Static breadth candidates count one endpoint sign, L1 coherence measures one cross-section, synchrony uses BTC-alt path correlations, and synchronized flip compares two half-block majorities. CLD-72 required prior leadership, flow alignment, BTC underreaction, and six-hour geometry. HVABDS uses the OLS time slope of eight disjoint hourly directional-participation shares inside the current block, with no BTC return direction, flow, volume, OI, funding, premium, prior event set, fitted outcome, or promoted control.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour BTC realized variation must occupy its causal upper 35%, while positive participation slope enters its upper 20%
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: offset three-daily within-auction cross-alt diffusion-slope onsets are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_block: 480 exact coherent bars_binance one-minute rows [D-8h,D) for each alt and BTC
features.hourly_alt_return: log(last completed close/first completed open) in each of eight disjoint exact hours, finite; zero contributes no directional participation
features.aggregate_alt_return: sum of each alt's eight hourly returns across all six alts, finite strict nonzero
features.hourly_participation: for aggregate direction s, fraction of six hourly alt returns having strict sign s
features.diffusion_slope: OLS slope of the eight hourly participation shares on fixed coordinates 0..7; finite strict positive
features.slope_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.80
features.btc_realized_variation: sqrt(sum squared exact BTC one-minute open-to-close log returns over [D-24h,D))
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 270 earlier source-valid decisions, minimum 180, current excluded; rank>=0.65
features.eligible_state: positive diffusion slope and both causal ranks pass
features.onset: eligible now and immediately preceding exact source-valid boundary ineligible; missing prior cannot trigger

clock.decision: D after all seven completed paths are available
clock.reservation: global half-open; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes
clock.rv20: q90 audit only after unchanged all-stage pass

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp and 10bp per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, and final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: independent within-auction acceleration of cross-alt directional participation

stopping_rule: terminal first failure; no universe, block, aggregation, slope, history, rank, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, source, or control repair
